text: Applicants must be high school graduates, at least 18 years of age, and usually under 50 years of age. The applicant must be determined not to have Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and hold a valid ordinary passport for personal reasons. According to Notice No. 12 of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China (2020), our University's supplementary regulations for international students applying for undergraduate studies are as follows:If both parents or one of the applicants is a Chinese citizen and settled abroad, and the applicant has foreign nationality at birth, in addition to meeting other registration qualifications, the applicant must also hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for more than 4 years (inclusive). Have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025) (the actual residence in a foreign country for at least 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry-exit signature).The applicant must be physically and mentally healthy, meet the physical examination requirements for visa or residence permit in China, and meet the physical examination standards of the major applied by our university, so as to ensure that he can study and live normally during his stay in China. Applicants should have good conduct, no disciplinary violations, no public security penalties, no criminal acts and records, be friendly to China, abide by Chinese laws and school rules and regulations, and respect the customs and habits of the Chinese people.
